crop.notes: Clipping covers the first column only, ending mid-sentence ('Veterans like Arthur Chambers, Joe'); the report continues in the next column and on page 3. The bottom piece also takes in part of the masthead. The Allen line is inside the clipping.

ocr.notes: Mostly right; scattered errors (e.g. '17 pounds' for 175, 'Sohnny').

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported John L. Sullivan's victory over Paddy Ryan at New Orleans, recalling in passing that Tom Allen had been swindled out of a victory over Joe Goss near Cincinnati in 1876 on a fraudulent claim of foul.

metadata.notes: Front page masthead: 'St. Louis Globe-Democrat, Wednesday Morning, February 8, 1882'. Special dispatch from New Orleans dated February 7.

facts.fact: The Globe-Democrat said Allen had been swindled out of a victory over Joe Goss near Cincinnati in 1876 on a fraudulent claim of foul

notes: Retrospective mention only; the fight was in Kentucky across from Cincinnati.
